entry.summary: A visitor visa on arrival for tourism, work or study, for 30 days.
entry.max_stay: 30 days; an entry permit is needed for longer
entry.other: Contact the Division of Immigration in Pohnpei for entry permits. Every vessel needs an entry permit.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The official currency is the US Dollar. Credit cards are accepted in most hotels. ATMs are limited. Contact your bank to make sure your cards will work overseas.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe, and include long jail sentences and heavy fines. - Carrying or using drugs
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: No laws restrict the rights of LGBTQIA+ people or groups. However, social and cultural attitudes to same-sex relationships can be conservative. Open affection between same-sex partners may attract negative attention and offend. - Advice for LGBTQIA+ travellers
laws.heading: LGBTQIA+ information

laws.rule: You can use your Australian driver's licence for 1 month after you arrive. After that, you must apply for a local licence.
laws.heading: Driving permit

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Dress and behaviour codes are conservative. Take care not to offend. If you're a woman, wear clothing that covers your knees.
